What number must be added to (4X2 - 7X - 13) so that it becomes divisible by (X - 2)?
questions.solution_en:
Remainder when f(X) = 4X2 - 7X - 13 is divided by (X - 2) = f (2)

f (2) = 4X2 - 7X - 13

= 4 * 22 - 7 * 2 - 13

= - 11

Hence, required number = X - 2 - (-11) = X + 9

questions.q_en: What is the value of m + 2n?
questions.solution_en:
On comparing both the sides, we get

12 + 2m = -12

2m = -24

m = -12

And -12 = 12 - 3n

-24 = -3n

n = 8

Therefore, m + 2n = -12 + 2 * 8 = -12 + 16 = 4

questions.q_en: If a and b are even negative numbers, then which of the following is an odd positive number?
questions.solution_en:
a and b are even negative numbers =>

a*b is positive even number.

(a) ab + 1 => positive odd number

(b) ab - 2 => positive/negative even number

(c) a + b => negative number

(d) 2(a + b) => negative number

Hence, option 'a' is correct.

Two numbers U and V are divided by 21, then remainder will be 8 and 17 respectively. When the product of U and V is divided by 21, then what will be the remainder?
questions.solution_en:
U = 21a + 8 and V = 21b + 17

=> UV = (21a + 8)(21b + 17)

=> UV = 441ab + 21a * 17 + 21b * 8 + 136

=> UV = 441ab + 21(17a + 8b) + 21 * 6 + 10

=> UV = 21(21ab + 17a + 8b + 6) + 10

Hence, remainder = 10

Express Method

U x V divided by 21 gives the same remainder as the product of their remainders divided by 21.

So, (8 x 17)/21 = 136/21 gives 10 as a remainder.

questions.q_en: A dishonest shopkeeper sells sugar at Rs. 27/kg which he has bought at Rs. 25/kg and he is giving 900 gm instead of 1000 gm. find his actual profit percentage.
questions.solution_en:
Shopkeeper buys sugar at Rs. 25/kg

Sells at Rs. 27/kg

He gives 900 grams of sugar but charges for 1000 grams.

Effective selling price per kg = 27/0.9 = Rs. 30/kg

Profit/kg = 30 - 25 = Rs. 5/kg

Required profit percentage = 5/25 * 100 = 20%

questions.q_en: There are 540 ml, 810 ml, and 900 ml of three different juices. They need to be poured into equal-sized bottles without mixing. How many bottles will be required?

questions.q_en: The number of males in coaches A and B, are in the ratio of 3: 2. The number of males in coach C is 20% more than the sum of number of males in coaches A and B. If the number of males in coaches B and C together is 400, then find the number of males in coach A.
questions.solution_en:
Let number of males in coaches A and B be 3x and 2x respectively.

Then,

Number of males in coach C = 5x * 120/100 = 6x

Given,

2x + 6x = 400

8x = 400

x = 50

Therefore,

Number of males in coach A = 3x = 3 * 50 = 150
